# Red Shovel Landscaping

> > Professional landscaping, groundskeeping, lawn care, and irrigation services serving Albuquerque and surrounding New Mexico communities.

Red Shovel Landscaping provides comprehensive outdoor property maintenance including lawn care, pest control, weed management, tree trimming, sprinkler repair, and seasonal services like Christmas lighting installation. They serve the greater Albuquerque metro area including Carnuel, Rio Rancho, Bernalillo, and other nearby communities.
